Author: natluenthaisong (fork of AnoMech by Anomek)
Name: NatMech
Punchline: AnoMech fork: FFXIV ultimate mechanics simulator. Go to an inn and start practice.
Description: A fork of AnoMech by Anomek. Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Adds Black Hole debuff automarkers, the D>S>A double tethers strategy for Dancing Mad P3, and arena camera zoom controls.
